info.title: BiG Equity 360 API
info.description: Local FastAPI backend for the BiG Equity 360 React dashboard. All data endpoints read the read-only serving snapshot (data/db/serving_<run>.duckdb). Dates are ISO yyyy-mm-dd, timestamps ISO-8601 UTC. Percent-like values are fractions (0.12 = 12%) unless the field name ends in _score/_pct where scale is 0..100 (scores) or 0..1 (rank_pct). Null means "not available". Errors use application/problem+json (Problem schema). v1.1 (additive): most object responses carry `data_status` (ok | partial | pending). `pending` means the upstream tables are not populated yet: arrays are empty, nullable fields are null and required scalar fields hold neutral placeholders (0, "", or the first enum value) that clients must not display. Region-filtered endpoints also accept `regions` (several regions). Snapshot-backed GET responses carry ETag / Last-Modified (serving run id). v1.5 (additive): Model Studio endpoints under /api/v1/studio (tag studio; schemas Studio*). v1.6 (additive): Studio Phase B (panel, causal, multivariate, volatility methods; plot kinds irf, fevd, event_path, regime_prob, ts_band), StudioTest.passed, run title/n_obs/estimated_seconds in every run status, ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in all result arrays. v1.7 (additive): Studio Phase C (regularized, tree_ensemble, gmm, density_clustering, factor_model, leaderboard; plot kinds coef_path, shap_beeswarm; dataset source factor_ls), POST /studio/leaderboard, scheduled studies (schedule / drift_threshold; drift alerts with rule_type studio_drift), peer sets saved from clustering runs (/studio/peer-sets, GET /companies/{security_id}/peers?peer_set_id=). v1.12.0 (additive, macro-w4): tag macro-v4 - /macro/v4/{factors, exposures, regime-performance, scenarios (CRUD + run), episodes}; CompanyMacro.macro_v4 (schema CompanyMacroV4) on /companies/{security_id}/macro; schemas MacroV4*; screener group macro + 6 ScreenerColumnId values (macro_beta_*, macro_impact_rates_down_100bp). All model-based. v1.13.0 (additive, macro-w3): tag macro-v3 - /macro/v3/central-banks, /macro/v3/central-banks/{bank}, /macro/v3/implied-paths; schemas MacroV3*. Official inputs only; implied paths are approximations from official curves (method + caveats returned); Taylor rules, expected inflation (ex-US) and tone are model-based (labelled). v1.14.0 (additive, macro-w3): MacroV3CentralBankSummary.tone_trend (last 12 tone scores); cb curve snapshots 3m / 6m / 1y in MacroV3CentralBank.implied_path.curves. v1.15.0 (additive, macro-w4): GET /macro/v4/regime-scopes; MacroV4ScenarioRunRequest.sectors / subsectors; MacroV4Exposures.frequency / frequencies_available (weekly only); CompanyMacroV4.episodes[].sector; ScreenerField.unit documented (pct = fraction). v1.16.0 (additive, events-v2): tag events-v2 - /events/v2/{taxonomy, map, timeline, stories, stories/{story_id}, labels/{label_type}/{label_id}, shocks, event-dates}; schemas EventsV2*. Labelled GDELT 2.0 events / GKG articles (issuers / sector / country or GLOBAL / market-theme bitmask), daily aggregates and news stories (near-duplicate clusters of all news sources). The v1 /events/* endpoints are unchanged. v1.17.0 (additive, realtime): tag live - GET /live/{filings, news, events, macro, alerts} (latest N from the real-time hot store merged over the nightly snapshot by natural key; origin live | snapshot | app_state), GET /live/stream (Server-Sent Events: id = global bus id, event = topic, Last-Event-ID resume, heartbeats), GET /live/status (per-stream lag / freshness / throughput / errors, bus topics, consumer-group lag); schemas Live*. Macro surprises are vs MODEL-BASED expectations (not consensus). Real-time prices are not part of this layer. Frontend generates TS types from this file (openapi-typescript). Performance budget: p95 < 300 ms per call. v1.18.0 (additive, event-models): tag events-models - GET /events/models/{hotspots, spillovers, connectedness, irf, escalation, changepoints, gpr, event-studies, company/{security_id}}; schemas EventsModels*. Spatial econometrics (Moran / LISA / Gi* hotspots, SAR / SEM / SDM / SLX spillovers, Diebold-Yilmaz connectedness, local projections, spatial VAR) and event dynamics (Hawkes escalation, BOCPD change points, GPR-style index, event-study library, company exposure); every output is model-based (model_based = true). v1.19.0 (additive, price-history): PriceSeries.first_date / daily_from - /companies/{security_id}/prices serves the full history (daily bars for the last 15 years, weekly bars before; the daily auto-resample cap is now 10 years); tag instruments - GET /instruments (browser: FX / futures / indices / ETFs by group with last, 1D / 1W / 1M / YTD / 1Y changes and a 1-year weekly sparkline), GET /instruments/{security_id} (stats, rolling 1y vol, correlations, source), GET /instruments/{security_id}/prices; schemas Instrument*. Yahoo market series: official FX for conversions remains ECB / Fed / central banks. v1.20.0 (additive, events-v2 history): window limits raised to 2,600 days (2020+ backfill) on /events/v2/{map, timeline, stories, labels, shocks}; map slider_freq + timeline_freq, label panel freq + freq field (weekly buckets by default beyond 400 days); coverage {first_date, last_date, n_days} on EventsV2Taxonomy and EventsV2Map. v1.21.0 (additive, cftc): tag positioning - GET /positioning/markets (latest headline positioning per CFTC market; filters asset_class / report / combined / active / major / security_id / q), GET /positioning/heatmap (COT index or z by market x trader category for one report family), GET /positioning/crowded (crowded longs / shorts / divergences), GET /positioning/markets/{market_code} (aligned weekly series per category + OI, traders, concentration, price of the mapped instrument, extremes, event study); schemas Positioning*. Source CFTC Commitments of Traders (official). Extremes / crowding / divergence / event study are model-based (labelled). v1.22.0 (additive, earnings): tag earnings - GET /earnings/calendar (earnings upcoming + released and corporate events in a date range; filters universe / watchlist / security_ids / region / sector / types / date_source), GET /companies/{security_id}/earnings (next date with source label, release history with CAR / BHAR reactions and model expectation vs actual, reaction stats, expectation rows per model, corporate events, PEAD signal), GET /earnings/season (earnings-season dashboard by region / sector); schemas Earnings*. AlertRuleType += earnings_upcoming {days_ahead?: int (default 3), date_sources?: [company_announced|provider_estimate|model_projection]} and earnings_surprise {threshold_z?: number (default 2.0), items?: [eps_diluted|revenue]}. Upcoming dates are labelled company-announced / provider estimate (Yahoo) / model-based projection; expectations and surprises are MODEL-BASED (not consensus). v1.23.0 (additive, cross-asset): tag cross-asset - GET /cross-asset/cockpit (assets x signals heatmap: trend, momentum, carry, value, curve slope, realised vol, IV/RV, CFTC positioning with z-scores; filters asset_class / security_id), GET /cross-asset/assets/{asset_id} (daily signal history, carry / value method, positioning), GET /cross-asset/curves and /cross-asset/curves/{root} (Yahoo futures term structures with APPROXIMATE expiry: latest vs ~1m / ~1y ago, contango / backwardation history, contract coverage served / missing / unchecked / expired), GET /cross-asset/correlation (eigen-concentration history + basket matrices now / 1m / 1y), GET /cross-asset/risk (MODEL-BASED risk-on / risk-off composite with components); schemas CrossAsset*. Model Studio dataset source cross_asset (field = asset_id:metric). Positioning is CFTC (official) joined point-in-time on the release date. v1.24.0 (additive, backtest): tag backtest - GET /backtest/catalog, POST /backtest/validate, POST /backtest/from-screen (Screener query -> point-in-time screen spec), /backtest/runs (submit sync / async on the worker, list, get, cancel, holdings, trades, export.py), POST /backtest/compare, /backtest/strategies (CRUD, run, schedule weekly = paper strategy with drift / decay alerts); schemas Backtest*. AlertRuleType += backtest_drift. Signals, universes and screens are evaluated point-in-time per rebalance (execution at the close of t+1); metrics carry a mandatory out-of-sample holdout, deflated Sharpe with a per-strategy multiple-testing counter, PBO (CSCV) for sweeps and a label-permutation test. Survivorship caveat: universe membership history starts 2026-10-10. v1.25.0 (additive, smart-money): tag smart-money - GET /smart-money/overview (13F accumulation / distribution, smart-cohort buying, crowding, most shorted, squeeze watch, SI risers, FTD spikes, combined score top / bottom, activist feed, EU / UK short register summary, CFTC equity-index positioning), GET /smart-money/eu-shorts (official EU / UK net short-position register: FCA, AMF, CNMV, AFM, CBI, FSMA, FI, Finanstilsynet; skipped registers listed), GET /smart-money/activism (13D / 13G event feed), GET /smart-money/sectors, GET /companies/{security_id}/ownership (13F holders with changes, ownership trend, short-interest trend, insider timeline, EU shorts, activism, score history); schemas SmartMoney*, CompanyOwnership*. 13F responses carry the lag (positions as of quarter end, filed by the cutoff). AlertRuleType += activist_13d {include_amendments?: bool (false), include_switch?: bool (true)}, short_interest_spike {min_chg_pct?: number (0.25), min_si_pct?: number (0.0)}, eu_short_position {min_pct?: number (0.5), include_increases?: bool (true), min_increase_pp?: number (0.1)}. Hedge-fund-like, smart cohort, crowding, squeeze, FTD spike and the combined score are MODEL-BASED (labelled); sources are official. v1.26.0 (additive, theses): tag theses - thesis tracker (roadmap #8): /theses (board listing with filters, create), /theses/stats (hit rates across closed theses), /theses/subject-defaults, /theses/{thesis_id} (get / patch incl. board moves and close with post-mortem template / delete), journal CRUD, reviews (schedule + complete), snapshots, status (live automatic status on track / at risk / invalidated with reasons + KPI values via the formula engine; model-based rules), evaluate (run the nightly thesis_eval for one thesis), performance (since inception vs benchmark and sector, shared price reader + official FX), timeline (price + bands + markers), evidence (filings, stories, event shocks, earnings, macro surprises), export.md; schemas Thesis*. Alert.thesis_id (rules generated by a thesis); AlertRuleType += thesis_kpi, thesis_review, thesis_status, thesis_catalyst, thesis_positioning, thesis_event_shock (managed by the thesis tracker, not creatable via POST /alerts; events written by thesis_eval). v1.27.0 (additive, supply-chain, roadmap v2 #9): tag supply-chain - GET /companies/{security_id}/network (disclosed customer / supplier edges depth 1-2 with provenance + labelled statistical neighbours), GET /companies/{security_id}/geography (direct / second-order / look-through exposure + country overlays), GET /supply-chain/country-risk, POST /supply-chain/shock (model-based damped propagation + optional W4 macro channel), POST /supply-chain/portfolio-exposure (watchlist / portfolio aggregation); schemas SupplyChain*, CompanyNetwork, CompanyGeography*, CountryRiskOverlay, PortfolioExposure*. v1.28.0 (additive, data ops O0/O1): GET /system/schedule + PUT /system/schedule (schedule profiles weekly / daily / intraday placeholder, hot-reloaded by the worker), GET /system/data-health (coverage registry datasets, freshness heatmap, gap queue, backfill campaigns with ETA, filler governor, source status + rate budgets, failures, SLA breaches, ops alerts); SystemStatus += scheduler, data_as_of (per region), data_as_of_overall, serving_sections, ops_alerts; FreshnessItem += optional; schemas Schedule*, SchedulerStatus, ServingSection, OpsAlert, DataHealth*. v1.30.0 (additive, O2.2c / O2.3): GET /system/qa (regression guard: API contract sweep, golden data checks, UI smoke suite; schemas QaReport, QaSuite, QaIssue) and DataHealth.qa; getMarketOverview += liquid / min_adv_usd / min_mcap_usd / min_price_usd / unknown_mcap_adv_multiple / movers_limit (liquid movers server-side, default on; unknown ADV no longer passes), MarketOverview.movers_filter (MoversFilter), MoverRow.adv_usd_20d; getEarningsCalendar += offset / compact, EarningsCalendar += offset / next_offset; backtestGetRun += series (full | weekly | none); BeneishDetail.corroboration (was served, now documented); FreshnessItem semantics for forward-looking tables and failed writers (F14). v1.31.0 (additive, O4 enterprise readiness): GET /ready (readiness probe: 200 when a serving snapshot is published and the worker heartbeat is fresh, else 503; schema Readiness), GET /metrics (Prometheus text exposition 0.0.4: HTTP request counts / latency histograms per route template, SSE connections, snapshot age, data age per table / region, dataset status, job outcomes, worker / filler state, gap queue). GET /health is the liveness probe (unchanged). Every response carries an `X-Request-ID` header (the caller's value when it is a safe token of <= 128 chars, otherwise generated) that is also written to the JSON logs. components.securitySchemes.bearerAuth documents the optional OIDC / JWT bearer authentication (Entra ID); it is enforced only when the server runs with BIG360_AUTH=oidc (default none: no authentication, local use) and then applies to /api/** (401 problem+json with a WWW-Authenticate header when the token is missing or invalid, 403 when the role is insufficient: viewer = reads and read-only computations, analyst = user-state writes, admin = job trigger / schedule / model train and promote).

get.summary: Cycle clock (growth momentum x inflation momentum) with a trail
get.description: Method (cycle_v1): growth momentum = mean of z-scored 6-month changes of the GDP y/y (q/q when no y/y), industrial production, retail sales and PMI-proxy cells; inflation momentum = same for CPI, core CPI and PPI. z = 6-month change / std of that change over the trailing 120 months (>= 36), clipped to +-3; composites are smoothed with a 3-month moving average. Quadrants: recovery (growth > 0, inflation <= 0), expansion (> 0, > 0), slowdown (<= 0, > 0), contraction (<= 0, <= 0). History uses latest revised data. When a cell's primary series is shorter than 42 months the longest current candidate series of that cell is used.

get.description: text/event-stream. Frames: `id: <bus id>` (global, strictly increasing), `event: <topic>` (filings | news | events | macro | alerts | signals) and `data: <LiveStreamEvent JSON>`. Control frames: `event: hello` (LiveStreamHello, first frame), `event: heartbeat` (LiveStreamHeartbeat, every heartbeat_s when idle; frames carry no id) and a `retry: 3000` hint. Resume: the browser's EventSource sends the Last-Event-ID header automatically on reconnect; the first connection may pass `last_event_id` (query) or `replay` (send the newest N retained messages first). Without either, the stream starts at the current head. Messages older than the hot-store retention (filings 14 d, news 7 d, events 72 h, macro 60 d, alerts 30 d) cannot be replayed.

StudioPlot.description: Plot data (arrays, no images). line/scatter/bar/errorbar use `series` (+ confidence_band [lo, hi] for ACF bars); scatter_points uses `points` [{label, cluster, x, y, sector_id}]; heatmap uses x (columns), y (rows), z (rows x columns); dendrogram uses scipy dendrogram output (icoord, dcoord, leaf_labels, leaves, color_list, cut_height); arrows uses `arrows` [{feature, x, y}] (PCA loadings biplot). v1.6 kinds: ts_band = shared date axis `x`, center lines in `series` [{name, x, y}], shaded `bands` [{name, lower, upper}] (same length as x), reference `hlines` [{y, label}] and `vlines` [{x, label}]; event_path = relative periods in `x` (integers), point estimates `y`, confidence interval `lower` / `upper`, `reference` (normalized period, e.g. -1, or null) and `event_x` (0 = event / treatment start); irf = `horizons` [0..H], `variables`, `orthogonalized`, `cells` [{impulse, response, mean, lower, upper}] (one cell per impulse x response, a k x k grid of small multiples); fevd = `horizons` [1..H], `variables`, `shares` [{response, impulse, share[]}] (for each response the shares over impulses sum to 1 at every horizon: one stacked-area chart per response); regime_prob = dates in `x`, `regimes` [{regime, label, prob[]}] (smoothed probabilities summing to 1) and an optional `overlay` {name, y} (the modelled series, for a secondary axis). v1.7 kinds: coef_path = `x` log10(alpha) grid (decreasing penalty), `paths` [{term, y[]}] standardized coefficients, vertical markers `selected_x` (chosen), `min_x` (min CV MSE), `one_se_x` (1-SE rule); shap_beeswarm = `features` [{feature, mean_abs, shap[], value[]}] sorted by mean |SHAP| (top 30); shap and value are aligned point arrays (<= 500 points), value = feature value scaled 0..1 (2nd-98th percentile) for colour.
